## Query Parameters

        - `id` (number)

        - `title` (string)

        - `assurance` (string)

        - `loan` (string)

        - `currency` (string)

        - `destination_currency` (null|string)

        - `dailyFee` (string)

        - `dailyFeeDiscount` (string)

        - `dailyFeeAfterDiscount` (string)
